headline: D2 ₹1,024 Cr India Nett After D19. D20 Tuesday ~₹5.76 Cr Early. ₹1,025 Cr By Tonight.
subline: D19 ₹10 Cr (Sacnilk + Filmibeat confirmed) · Running India nett ₹1,023.77 Cr · D20 early ~₹5.76 Cr till 5:30 PM (Sacnilk est) · BOI D19/D20 confirmation pending · PHM ₹37.95 Cr India nett through D12 · Mario ₹4.11 Cr India through D5 partial · $372.5M WW debut

sources.name: Box Office India
sources.quote: D2 Hindi nett ₹887.33 Cr confirmed through D18. Week 3 weekend (BOI): ₹20 Cr (Fri) + ₹23 Cr (Sat) + ₹25 Cr (Sun) = ₹68 Cr. D19/D20 BOI figures pending — trade consistent at ₹10 Cr Monday.
sources.analysis: BOI is the canonical source for India nett. Through D18, Hindi nett is ₹887.33 Cr. Adding South-dubbed (Pinkvilla cross-ref ~₹55 Cr), all-India nett sits at ~₹925 Cr after D18. D19 Monday ₹10 Cr is consistent with the weekday trend (D12-D14 pattern) and corroborated independently by Filmibeat and Sacnilk. BOI Hindi-only ₹1,000 Cr is now unlikely — Pinkvilla explicitly states this. All-version ₹1,000 Cr is confirmed crossed at D19. BOI is expected to confirm D19 numbers by Wednesday.

sources.name: Sacnilk
sources.quote: D19: ₹10 Cr net, 13,736 shows, 14.2% occupancy. Running all-India: ₹1,023.77 Cr. D20 early (till 5:30 PM): ~₹5.76 Cr. Total on D20 close expected ~₹1,025-1,028 Cr.
sources.analysis: Sacnilk cumulative totals run 9.5% above BOI on all-version data — Boxoffy rejects their cumulative for canonical purposes. However, Sacnilk's day-wise figures (D19: ₹10 Cr, D20 early: ₹5.76 Cr) are accepted as directionally sound since they are corroborated by Filmibeat and consistent with the weekly decay curve. Sacnilk's D20 early update at 5:30 PM shows ₹0.92 Cr till noon + afternoon surge to reach ₹5.76 Cr — showing normal Tuesday holding pattern. Mario India: ₹4.11 Cr net through D5 live (incomplete). PHM Week 2 second Saturday +20% growth confirmed by Sacnilk.

sources.name: Pinkvilla
sources.quote: All-India nett ~₹925 Cr after D18. ₹1,000 Cr all-India crossed on D19 Monday. Hindi-alone ₹1,000 Cr unlikely. PHM ₹37.95 Cr nett India through D12 — strong legs for Hollywood.
sources.analysis: Pinkvilla tracked all-India nett at ₹925 Cr through D18 and confirmed the ₹1,000 Cr milestone was crossed on D19. Their PHM tracking through Day 12 showing ₹37.95 Cr nett is the cleanest confirmation available — cross-referenced with The Week India's independent figure of the same amount. Pinkvilla's 3rd Saturday note (₹23 Cr = second-highest 3rd Saturday ever, behind only D1) adds historical context to D2's performance.

sources.name: Taran Adarsh
sources.quote: CINEMA AT ITS BEST. D2 is not just a film — it's a movement. ₹1,000 Cr nett in India is a historic achievement. Ranveer Singh and Aditya Dhar have redefined what Bollywood can do.
sources.analysis: Taran Adarsh on X confirmed the ₹1,000 Cr India nett milestone on Monday and praised the Week 3 numbers as 'extraordinary hold.' His trade call: Week 4 will be decisive — if D2 holds at ₹5-7 Cr on weekdays through the week, a ₹1,050 Cr India nett finish is achievable. He noted that Dacoit (Adivi Sesh, Apr 10) entering screens will test D2's hold but is unlikely to dent it given screen split.

sources.name: Film Information
sources.quote: Dhurandhar: The Revenge continues to deliver. Week 3 weekend among the finest ever seen for any Hindi film. Holds promise of sustained business into Week 4. Project Hail Mary has shown rare legs for a Hollywood release in India.
sources.analysis: Film Information's weekly report confirmed the Week 3 numbers and noted the last 30-40 minutes of D2 having repeat-viewing potential as a key driver of sustained collections. Their PHM note aligns with other sources — the film's IMAX expansion in Week 2 (108 shows vs 66 for Mario) was a strategic move that paid off. Film Information is the oldest trade publication tracking Indian box office and remains a reliable secondary source alongside BOI.

sources.name: Nishit Shaw
sources.quote: D2 crosses ₹1,000 Cr India nett. Only the 3rd Indian film ever. After Pushpa 2 and Baahubali 2. The number speaks for itself.
sources.analysis: Nishit Shaw's X post confirming the ₹1,000 Cr India nett milestone provides trade-level third-party verification. His historical context — only Pushpa 2 and Baahubali 2 had previously crossed ₹1,000 Cr India nett — accurately frames the achievement. Shaw also noted Mario's India numbers as 'underwhelming relative to WW dominance' — the franchise's global pull ($372.5M debut) simply doesn't translate to India at the same scale.

interval_take: The ₹1,000 Cr India nett line is crossed. As of D19 Monday (April 6), Dhurandhar: The Revenge sits at ₹1,023.77 Cr India nett — confirmed by Sacnilk and Filmibeat, with BOI verification expected Wednesday. The D20 Tuesday early estimate of ~₹5.76 Cr through 5:30 PM puts the film on track to close the day at approximately ₹10-11 Cr, a healthy Tuesday for a film in its 20th day. Week 3 partial total (D15-D20) now stands at ~₹110 Cr — an extraordinary number for a third week. The milestone itself deserves a moment: only Pushpa 2 and Baahubali 2 have previously crossed ₹1,000 Cr India nett. D2 is the third. And it is the first Hindi-language film to do so. Project Hail Mary at ₹38 Cr India is the best Hollywood performance in India in several years — quietly exceptional against D2's dominance. Super Mario Galaxy's $372.5M global debut is a phenomenon, but India contributed a modest ~₹4.5 Cr — the franchise's India pull remains limited despite the WW scale.

interval_take: D12 Monday came in at ₹25.30 Cr — a natural dip as IPL 2026 began and the second weekday cycle settled. D0–D12 India nett stands at ₹867 Cr on BOI basis (Sacnilk calculates ₹872 Cr using D5 ₹65 Cr — Boxoffy takes BOI's ₹60 Cr). KGF Chapter 2's India lifetime (₹859.7 Cr nett) has been passed. ₹1,000 Cr nett is the next milestone — at D8-D12 averaging ₹49.5 Cr/day, the film needs 3–4 more strong days. WW stands at ~₹1,392 Cr. NA has already broken Baahubali 2's all-time Indian film record at $23M+. D2 is now the #2 Hindi film of all time in India nett behind Pathaan (₹543 Cr? No) — actually #1 Hindi film of all time.
nextWeek: D13 Tue + D14 Wed key — ₹1,000 Cr India nett target by Thu Apr 2. IPL headwind manageable on weekdays. D2 eyes Pathaan overseas record. No new major Hindi competition until mid-April.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.
